I wish my mother could have seen Georgia last night.

When she called on women to become the soul of the nation, she was asking us to help shape what this country stands for and how it treats its people. She spent her life putting those words into action.

I thought of her as Keisha Lance Bottoms became the first Black woman elected governor of a U.S. state. I thought, too, of the Black women who went door to door, registered voters and organized for years. Many did not live to see what they helped make possible.

Congratulations, Governor-elect Bottoms. Congratulations also to Penny Brown Reynolds, Georgia’s next secretary of state, and Tanya Miller, our next attorney general.

I’m thinking of the Black girls who will grow up seeing women who look like them lead Georgia. I pray they see what my mother saw in leadership: the power to make life better for others and the responsibility to use it.

I hate to say I warned you.

But I warned you.

What happened last night should be a wake-up call.

It wasn't because Democrats cheated.

It wasn't because accounts on X started criticizing Trump and the GOP a month before the election.

It happened because President Trump and the Republican Party failed to deliver on what mattered most to the American people.

Did you hear what I just f'n said?

THEY FAILED THE AMERICAN PEOPLE!

For the last four to six months, all I heard on X was the same recycled bullshit from the MAGA influencers.

"Pass the SAVE Act!"

"John Thune needs to go!"

"Trump has historic support!"

Kiss my red, white and blue blooded ass!

And because these f'n frauds kept repeating the same talking points, everyone else on X convinced themselves that everything was wonderful.

But here's what some of you desperately need to understand.

X IS NOT REAL LIFE.

If I walked up to 100 random Americans and asked them who Libs of TikTok or Dr. Clown was, I'd bet 99 of them wouldn't have a fcking clue what I was talking about.

And the 100th would probably ask me if Dr. Clown was accepting new patients.

That's how disconnected from reality some accounts on here have become.

They think because somebody has 2 million followers on X, they're a household name. 

Meanwhile, the average American couldn't pick these people out of a police lineup if their life depended on it.

Nobody at the grocery store gives a shit about the latest viral AI video. Nobody at the gas pump is celebrating because an X influencer got 10,000 reposts.

INTERNET CELEBRITIES ARE NOT AMERICA.

You know what I saw outside of X?

I saw exhausted Americans.

People with bags under their eyes.

People stressed about their mortgages.

People struggling to afford groceries.

People watching their savings disappear.

People working their asses off and still falling behind.

People looking at their bank accounts and wondering how the hell they're going to make it through another month.

And I kept hearing the same heartbreaking sentence.

"I don't know what I'm going to do."

THAT was the America I was talking about.

THAT was the American who voted last night. 

Not the America you see in your carefully curated timeline.

And for the last month, I tried telling you about how ordinary Americans were reaching their breaking point.

And what happened?

You called me a traitor.

You told me I wasn't a real conservative.

You attacked me for daring to criticize our president.

You treated legitimate concerns about people's financial struggles like some kind of betrayal.

Well, guess what?

You can silence criticism inside your little MAGA bubble, but you cannot silence reality outside of it.

I'm pissed off because I saw the warning signs, spoke up about them, and watched people attack anyone who dared acknowledge them.

And now some of those same people are looking everywhere for someone to blame.

Here's my message.

Stop blaming everyone who warned you and start holding the people in power accountable.

Because here's the reality that no social media cheerleading can change.

Americans don't pay their mortgages with political slogans.

They don't fill their refrigerators with presidential approval posts.

And they sure as hell don't pay their electric bills with stupid f'n AI videos mocking Democrats. 

These MAGA grfiters spent months telling people how great America was doing.

But voters spent those same months wondering how they were going to survive.

And that disconnect is exactly what I've been trying to tell you about.

You can win every argument on X and still lose touch with the country.

Because at the end of the day, Americans don't live inside your timeline.

They live inside their budgets.

#BREAKING Reports are pouring in of voting disruptions hitting multiple counties in Michigan, Kansas, Pennsylvania, and Georgia on election day with voters and observers describing power outages, ballot shortages, jammed machines, emergency boxes, and fake texts that some say is deliberate interference by Democrats. 

Here are some incidents:

🔷Wayne County, Michigan:
#Michigan
Power outages that will last until about 7:40 PM, 20 minutes before polls closed.
Separate reports of tabulator malfunctions in places like Madison Heights, Redford Township, and Shelby Township. 
This county had problems in 2022 with significant delays.

🔷Leavenworth County (Linwood Community Center), Kansas: 
#kansas
Polling place ran out of paper ballots, they had about 100 when they needed about 1,000. 
Officials say it was due to a county clerk ordering error. 
Voters were turned away or waited over an hour.

🔷Multiple counties in Pennsylvania: 
#Pennsylvania
Voters reporting that ballot scanners are jammed, missing, or not set up, with poll workers putting completed ballots into emergency boxes, bins, or folders to scan after the polls close. 
Problems in 2022 with machine and process issues.

🔷Fulton County, Georgia: 
#Georgia
Voters reported receiving fake text messages claiming their polling locations had changed. 

Separate earlier scanner failures during early voting affected over 1,000 ballots that required rescanning or transfer
Problems in 2022

Same-day reports of midterm voting equipment failures, scanner jams, ballot shortages, power or technical delays, fake messages, and related disruptions are being reported in states including: 

🔷New York: Scanners stopped accepting ballots early, emergency bags used, barcode issues cited, machines down or jammed.
#newyork
🔷Georgia: Scanner failures and fake texts, Scanners out
#Georgia
🔷Florida: Check-in delays, one site relocated for flooding
#florida
🔷Pennsylvania: Scanner problems, emergency boxes, some precincts delayed or extended

🔷Ohio: Machines down plus a bomb threat evacuation, early glitch on “already voted” status
#Ohio
🔷Mississippi: check-in or machine issues at multiple sites
#Mississippi
🔷North Carolina: Technical delays, printer/power issues
#NorthCarolina
🔷Wisconsin: Scanner failures, ballots to auxiliary boxes
#Wisconsin
🔷California: Official drop box overflowed, Ballots on ground then bagged into a minivan
#califonia
🔷Indiana: Machines failed at opening
#Indiana
🔷Oklahoma: Machine issues, Emergency bins
#oklahoma
🔷Nevada: Machine unavailability
#nevada
🔷Virginia: Mail-in ballots already submitted in someone else's name
#Virginia
🔷Kansas: Ballot shortage from ordering error

🔷South Carolina: Machines down
#SouthCarolina
🔷Michigan: Power outages and tabulator malfunctions
Republicans say these are red flags and should be immediately investigated, especially in counties with prior voting issues like Wayne and Fulton. 

They say equipment failures, emergency containers, and voter-suppression-style messages are proof that there should be paper-trail verification, observer access, and post-election audits rather than just accepting “routine glitch” explanations. 

Officials counter that the same procedures have been used for years without proven outcome-changing fraud.

Do you think these problems are simply accidents, or is it time for stronger election integrity measures?

Whew.

It’s finally time to rip the veil because I was not going to be the cause of disenfranchising a single voter.

I owed it to my nation to never tell anyone not to vote (and exercise their Constitutional duty to do so — and I fought for that right) and I would have never been responsible for it. I made it a promise to myself that I would not do this. 

So here goes…

I will sort of break down the system of catastrophic events that led down to tonight. Not from a political pundit. Not from a newspaper or magazine. Just a normal guy that has talked to hundreds of people on both political spectrums.

Let’s begin six months before primary season. I joined a political organization called RINO Removal Project. From the very beginning we were always told that the idea of the project was incredible. Even Charlie Kirk was in our group chat. We were constantly harassed by jealous members of the…wait for it…alleged Conservatives. You do not know what hell we have all experienced, the slander, the jealousy, the lack of support, etc. 

Now let’s get to the real meat and potatoes of what really caused this bloodbath tonight.

THE IRAN WAR: Even though every President since the 1970’s has stated that Iran was a threat, Trump gambled. But unfortunately…this was utilized by the left. I truly think this backfired immensely when he stated that this wasn’t a “war”. Optics were terrible.

EPSTEIN CLIENT LIST: Holy good God. This was one of the main things that was run on. And then nothing. They released some
“Documents” but no one was arrested for it. The only two people that were held accountable were Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell. Just think about this. Maxwell is in prison for trafficking and not one single client was arrested.

ILLEGAL IMMIGRATION: We needed millions more out of this country. Plain and simple. Replacing Greg Bovino was the worst choice ever.

PRICES OF LITERALLY EVERYTHING: We can blame everything on Joe Biden or Trump but at the end of the day, I can’t walk outside of the grocery store for less than $100. Saying things like “I would pay $50/gallon of gas to attack Iran” was the most braindead thing I have ever heard in my life. This is coming from a combat Veteran that understand what the Military Industrial Complex is before you test.

SAVE America ACT: What an absolute disaster. Don’t even get me started.

Mind you, the GOP controlled both chambers of Congress and the Presidency. I’m not putting all blame on the President. Thune is responsible. The neocons still in power (or that got primaried) are the problem. But at the end of the day…

They. Both. Don’t. Care. About. You.

But I’m kind of done with this back and forth of both sides crushing each other but we never get to the root of the problem.

>Americans are angry. 
>Americans are overworked and underpaid. (I got so much heat before by stating the simple truth)
>Americans are being surveilled even more.
>Americans are tired of sending money overseas.

Do I continue to use my voice in the political spectrum? I’m not sure. It’s very unforgiving and have been attacked relentlessly from both the left and the right when at the end of the day….

There are delusional people on both sides.

What’s going to happen? Who knows?

I’m done with GOP. We need a brand-new GOP with actual balls that love this country and not their own pocketbooks.

You failed the American people, tremendously. And that is an absolute understatement.

Plain and simple.

items.t: Say Republicans lose the House and the Senate. Then what? Start with the Senate. It's been a graveyard under Thune. John Thune is a Bush Republican — RINO, Rep
items.tx:
Say Republicans lose the House and the Senate. Then what?

Start with the Senate. It's been a graveyard under Thune. John Thune is a Bush Republican — RINO, Republican In Name Only — to his bones. As Majority Leader, he has spent two years managing Democrats instead of defeating them. When your own leader already treats the minority like a partner, handing it the gavel is a change of nameplate, not of direction.

Now the House. A Democratic House has one real move: investigate. Hearings. Document demands. Another round of hearings. That is the entire playbook. But a congressional subpoena is only paper until somebody enforces it. A contempt referral goes to the Justice Department. If the demand is a partisan fishing trip, DOJ has no duty to chase it. Without DOJ, nobody is forced to comply and nobody pays a price. It's cameras, not consequences. One caveat — they control the purse strings. Investigations may go nowhere, but a Democratic House can still choke funding for anything the administration wants. What they can't do is defund DOJ. The one lever that makes the rest of their playbook work is the one lever they don't hold. Even if Republicans lose the House, the administration doesn't lose its investigative arm. Trump's Fraud Whistleblower Incentive Program does the same work the House would — gathering tips, routing them to inspectors general, surfacing fraud in programs like SNAP, healthcare, and unemployment — except it sits inside DOJ, which controls intake, routing, and charging. A Democratic House can subpoena all it wants. This mechanism doesn't need their permission to move. That's the difference between a stage and a courtroom. And the tips aren't coming only from Republicans. The Somali fraud network in Minnesota has already pulled in Democratic officials and donors — and the same program isn't limited to one state. If the dime drops in California or Michigan or anywhere else, DOJ follows it. Unlike a congressional witch hunt, which dies the moment DOJ shrugs, these investigations end in charges. That's not a witch hunt when the evidence walks in the door on its own.

A double loss would also rattle Iran. With Washington gridlocked after January, Trump would have every incentive to settle accounts with Tehran before the new Congress can tie his hands. Distraction at home is the one thing that historically slows him down abroad — remove it, and the clock on Tehran speeds up.

Then there is the pardon power. Article II, plain as day. And Democrats wrote the newest rules for it themselves. Joe Biden pardoned his son Hunter for anything going back to 2014. On his way out the door, he pardoned Anthony Fauci, Gen. Mark Milley, the entire January 6 committee and its staff, and five members of his own family. Most of them were never charged with anything. They were pardoned in advance. So if Democrats take the House tonight and aim witch hunts at Trump or his allies, that same precedent means a lot of people could be shielded for the last ten years before any charge ever lands. When the same party that cheered all of that cries abuse over a pardon, ask them a simple question: where was your conscience in January 2025? That standard cuts both ways, starting at the ballot box.

If the night ends badly, don't despair. Two years of Democrat subpoenas aren't a government. They're a stage.

-- Joseph Fosco
November 3, 2026
